description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git commands and behaviors, including diff operations, conflict detection, and submodule handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a success condition for a test step with a descriptive message.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Verifies that a command fails as expected.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new repository in a subdirectory for testing.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Commits changes in a subdirectory, optionally with a specified message.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock or timestamp used during tests.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
